Built `workspace/middleware/rate_limit.xs` and policies `RATE-001` and `LOG-011`, but the limiter is not attached to any endpoint yet, so it limits nothing. Confidence: low.

The dry run is clean (creates the middleware and both policies, no blocked objects). I could not find the XanoScript form for attaching middleware to the `app` API group, so that change is not made and `RATE-001` is set to advisory rather than the planned blocking. Until the attachment exists, the policy flags every public endpoint, login and signup included. Plan, result and what to check before pushing are in `out/reply.md`; the product-team log is in `out/notes.json`.
